Salary: $79,500 - $85,000
Work type: Permanent Full Time

Who are we?
Trippas White Group is a leader in the hospitality industry, operating premium restaurants, cafés, catering and event services across Australia. Our prestigious portfolio includes iconic venues, educational institutions, corporate locations and cultural destinations. Working for Trippas White Group opens endless career opportunities across our diverse and growing collection of venues.

The Venue
Canberra Grammar School is one of Australia's leading independent schools, renowned for its commitment to academic excellence, innovation and community engagement. Located in the heart of Canberra, the School offers exceptional dining and catering services to students, staff, families and guests. From daily food service operations to special events and functions, the culinary team plays an important role in delivering high-quality food experiences across the campus.

We want you!
We are seeking a professional Chef to join our dynamic kitchen team and enjoy the fast-paced environment that school catering and hospitality has to offer. We are looking for an outstanding individual with experience in busy kitchen operations, catering, functions and events, and a passion for delivering fresh, high-quality food.

Do you have?
Minimum 2 years' experience in a professional kitchen
Relevant Chef qualifications or equivalent trade experience
HACCP and sound Food Safety knowledge
Experience working in high-volume catering environments
Ability to work across a range of food service offerings, including daily operations, events and functions
Exceptional grooming and pride in presentation
Ability to produce quality food using fresh ingredients and demonstrate creativity
Strong organisational and time management skills
Passion, dedication, reliability and a willingness to learn
Flexible and positive attitude with excellent communication and customer service skills
Ability to work collaboratively within a professional team environment

Then we want to hear from you!
Join a professional hospitality team and contribute to delivering exceptional dining experiences within one of Canberra's most respected educational institutions.

Trippas White Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages applications from people of all backgrounds, including First Nations Australians.

01 Jul 2026 to 02 Aug 2026

FORMWORK CARPENTER 
KWIK FORMWORK
JANDAKOT, PERTH WA 6164 
FULL-TIME PERMANENT

Position Overview
As a Formwork Carpenter at KWIK FORMWORK, you will play a pivotal role in the construction, erection, and installation of formwork for various structures on key projects. This position requires a skilled tradesperson with leadership abilities to ensure the successful completion of tasks while maintaining high standards of safety and quality.

Key Responsibilities
•	Review and Interpret Plans: Carefully review and interpret project plans and blueprints to identify the materials needed, dimensions, and the best installation approach.
•	Material Selection and Planning: Select and order the necessary materials and prepare detailed layouts for the formwork construction process.
•	Construct, Erect, and Install Formwork: Execute precise measurements and work from technical drawings to create and set up formwork for concrete structures.
•	Installation of Cladding and Fixtures: Install fascia panels, roof sheathing, and fit exterior cladding, along with door and window frames, to complete the formwork.
•	Maintenance and Repairs: Carry out repairs on existing formwork and structures as needed, ensuring they remain functional and up to standard.
•	Versatile Material Handling: Work with a range of materials, including laminates, Perspex, and metals, as required by the project.
•	Lead and Supervise: Oversee a team of formwork carpenters, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and to a high standard.
•	Safety Compliance: Adhere to and enforce safety protocols on-site, ensuring a safe working environment for all team members.
•	Quality Control: Inspect and verify the quality of the formwork installation, ensuring it meets project specifications and industry standards.
•	Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, engineers, and other trades to coordinate and streamline the construction process.
•	Problem-Solving: Identify and address any issues that arise during the formwork installation process, finding effective solutions to keep the project on track.
•	Training and Mentoring: Provide guidance and training to less experienced team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Qualifications and Skills
•	Cert III Equivalent & Experience: This position requires a Certificate III equivalent or a minimum of 3 years’ experience in the trade.
•	Industry Knowledge: Demonstrated industry knowledge is essential for this position.
•	WA Building and Construction Industry Card: A current WA Building and Construction Industry White/Blue Card is mandatory.
•	Technical Proficiency: Ability to read and interpret drawings accurately.
•	High-Rise Experience: Prior experience in high-rise construction is highly desirable.

SENIOR PIGGERY STOCKPERSON 
Location: Mount Mercer, VIC 3352 
Tenure: Full-time Permanent 
Salary: From $71,481 per year (plus superannuation) 

Required Skills and Experience:
•	AQF Certificate III (or higher/equivalent) qualification in Agriculture (Pig Production);
•	At least 3 years recent relevant experience in a medium to large size commercial piggery

Position Summary: 
On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment Services is looking for a skilled and experienced Senior Piggery Stockperson who can join the production team of a piggery company with multiple farm sites. 
Must have strong communication and time management skills, self-motivated and must have the ability to work independently and as a member of a team.
Tasks and duties include: 
•	Supervise the site and facilities in terms of the required human resources, physical resources, safety requirements, consumables, documentation and measurement devices
•	Provide overall maintenance and compliance of the Company Quality Assurance program for the site ensuring that all relevant documentation is kept current;
•	Supervise data collection and recording so information is accurate to aid stock and inventory control
•	Undertake specific tasks assigned by management to ensure that environmental, quality and safety goals are met
•	Implement preventable maintenance programs to reduce planned and unplanned down time
•	Supervise trial sheds, collect and record data in accordance with trial protocols
•	Selection of breeding stock and/or pigs for sale
•	Supervision and participation of daily inspection of livestock, such that the animals are appropriately fed, watered, environmental parameters are fulfilled. The Senior Stockperson (Piggery) in this case would work with and supervise a less experienced Stockperson
•	Supervision and participation of daily inspection of livestock, ensuring compromised animals are individually assessed, identified, treated and record in accordance with the Company Herd Health Plan and the industries Model Code of Practice
•	Euthanise sick or injured stock in a humane manner and in accordance with the Model Code of Practice for Animal Welfare – Pigs 3rd edition
•	Conduct post mortem examinations of deceased stock and report findings
•	Supervision and participation in the mating of animals via individually supervised mating or through Artificial Insemination
•	Supervision of the birthing process, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments of females during parturition to minimise this incidence of still births
•	Participate in company/industry training sessions and workshops as required;
•	Perform any other duty as required by the Unit Manager.

Other skills required:
•	Good verbal and written communication skills;
•	Advanced and extensive knowledge in animal husbandry, animal welfare, and pig production;
•	Knowledge in using computer system is an advantage.

Qualified applicants may apply online.

result.description:
About the Organisation
Twisted Sista Global Pty Ltd is an established and expanding café and gelateria
group, operating multiple franchised locations across Victoria. The brand is
recognised for its innovative menu offerings, high-volume service environment, and
strong operational systems.
As part of our continued growth, we are seeking to appoint an Executive Chef to lead
culinary operations across our network.
The Opportunity
This is a senior leadership position responsible for the strategic and operational
direction of all food-related functions across six (6) franchise locations.
The role requires a highly experienced professional capable of
delivering consistency, scalability, and innovation within a multi-site environment.
Key Responsibilities
? Lead the planning, development, implementation, and continuous
improvement of food menus, recipes, and seasonal offerings across all
venues within the group.
? Develop, standardise, and maintain recipes, portion controls, plating
specifications, and food presentation standards to ensure consistency and
quality across kitchen operations.
? Oversee kitchen operations and monitor food preparation methods, cooking
standards, and presentation quality across all locations to ensure consistency
with brand and culinary standards.
? Supervise, train, and mentor kitchen staff, head chefs, and franchise kitchen
teams in food preparation techniques, kitchen procedures, food safety
standards, and presentation requirements.
? Develop and implement kitchen operational procedures and production
workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and service standards across
multiple sites.
? Coordinate supplier sourcing and procurement of food products and kitchen
supplies, while monitoring food costs, stock usage, wastage, and portion
control measures.
? Ensure compliance with food safety legislation, hygiene regulations, kitchen
sanitation requirements, and safe food handling procedures across all kitchen
operations.
? Support the establishment of new store locations by assisting with kitchen
setup, menu implementation, workflow planning, and training of kitchen
personnel.
? Conduct regular audits of kitchen operations, food quality, storage
procedures, and presentation standards, and implement corrective actions
where required.
? Collaborate with senior management regarding menu direction, product
development, and operational improvements to support business growth and
customer satisfaction.
Essential Requirements
? Diploma or higher qualification in a closely related filed (e.g. Kitchen
Management/Commercial Cookery/Hospitality Management), or else 3 years
of relevant working experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
? Minimum 3 years’ experience as a Chef in a busy commercial kitchen,
including leadership responsibilities
? In-depth knowledge of Australian food safety standards and compliance
frameworks
? Ability to travel between locations as required
Highly Regarded
? Experience in a senior culinary leadership role (Executive Chef / Group Chef /
Head Chef – Multi-site)
To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your relevant
experience and suitability for the role.

Pay: $95,000.00 – $115,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

result.description:
If you're looking for ongoing work with full-time hours and the opportunity to secure stable employment, this could be the perfect role for you!


The team at Flexiforce are seeking an enthusiastic Labourer to do process work for a well-established Manufacturing company out in Mittagong, NSW.
	
The successful applicant will be using tools to assemble steel frames & trusses on a production line for a company specialising in manufacturing prefabricated building components.

This is a hands-on production role suited to someone who enjoys working with tools in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

What’s on offer: 
•	Ongoing employment. 
•	5 days a week, Monday - Friday.
•	Immediate start.


Work Hours: 
Mon – Thu: 7am – 3.30pm
Fri: 7am – 1pm


Main Responsibilities Include:
•	Assembly process work
•	Manufacturing frame & trusses on a production line
•	Using hand tools & power tools 
•	Conducting quality checks to ensure products meet specifications
•	Maintaining a clean and safe work environment
•	General ad hoc tasks, as required


Essential Requirements:
•	Previous experience in a similar role
•	Proven ability to utilise hand & power tools safely and efficiently
•	Strong work ethic and positive attitude
•	Physically capable of repetitive manual work
•	Efficient time management skills
•	Capable of working both independently and as part of a team
•	Reliability is a MUST!


If this sounds like the right job for you, please apply ASAP!

Please send your résumé to enquiries@flexiforce.com.au
Any queries, please contact our team: 02 4869 5505


If you do not include your resume, this will mark the application as incomplete.
result.title: Process Worker
